record.title: Brazil’s MGI reports Chat GOV.BR had reached more than 5.6 million users
record.summary: In a Nov 3, 2026, official update, Brazil’s Ministry of Management and Innovation in Public Services said its Chat GOV.BR public information service, launched in 2026, had reached more than 5.6 million users. The service provides conversational access to public information through simple-language chat, including WhatsApp. The figure is a ministry-reported reach measure; its as-of date, user definition and measurement method are not stated. It does not establish resolution, accuracy, service quality, cost savings or causal impact.
organizations: Brazil Ministry of Management and Innovation in Public Services (MGI)

claims.label: DEMONSTRATED
claims.text: Brazil’s Ministry of Management and Innovation in Public Services published an update on 2026-11-03 describing Chat GOV.BR as a public AI service launched in 2026.

claims.label: CLAIMED
claims.text: The MGI release states that Chat GOV.BR had reached more than 5.6 million users; the release does not specify the measurement as-of date, unique-user definition or method.

claims.label: NOT_ESTABLISHED
claims.text: The available release does not establish how many users completed tasks, whether advice was accurate or accessible, service quality, cost savings or causal public benefit.

evidence_gaps.description: The MGI release does not define the >5.6m user count, measurement window, unique-user treatment or collection method.
The release reports reach but no task resolution, answer quality, accessibility or public-service outcome evidence.

brief.importance_rationale: If the reported reach is accurate, millions of users interacting with a government AI information service would inform public-sector deployment and service-channel choices; reach alone does not establish task success or public benefit.
limitations: The 5.6-million figure is an MGI-reported reach claim; its exact measurement window, unique-user definition, collection method and denominator are not disclosed.
No independent service-quality, task-resolution, accuracy, accessibility, cost or causal-outcome evaluation was inspected.
A user reach count does not establish that individual users successfully completed a public-service task or benefited from the service.

technical.claimed_result: MGI states that Chat GOV.BR had reached more than 5.6 million users as of an unspecified date.
technical.compute_or_cost: No service operating cost, model/provider, interaction volume or cost-per-successful-task measure is given in the announcement.
technical.demonstrated_result: The dated MGI announcement establishes that the ministry publicly described the 2026-launched service and its claimed reach. The reported 5.6-million figure is not independently audited in this record.
technical.implementation_status: MGI describes the service as launched in 2026 and available through conversational interactions, including WhatsApp.
technical.mechanism: Conversational AI service offering information and guidance across public policies and services through plain-language interactions, including WhatsApp.
technical.regime: A Brazilian federal public-information service reported by MGI in a Nov 3, 2026 update; reach measure is >5.6 million users with unspecified measurement window and definition.
technical.reproducibility: No underlying analytics export, collection method or independent validation was available in this review.
technical.strongest_baseline: No prior service baseline, control service or measured task-completion comparison is supplied.

brief.title: Brazil’s MGI reports Chat GOV.BR had reached more than 5.6 million users
brief.why_it_matters: A government-reported reach above 5.6 million users is a meaningful deployment-scale signal for public-sector AI service planning. The number should be treated as a reported reach claim, not evidence that users’ needs were resolved or that the service improved outcomes.
